meaning:
χειμάζω
(χεῖμα, winter cold) [in LXX: Pro.26:10 (†) * ;]
1. to expose to winter cold, go into winter quarters.
2. to drive with storm; pass., to be driven with storm, tempest-tossed: Act.27:18.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
